text:
maria_marketing: Quick kickoff: we need a "Playbook Lite" one-pager for the webinar follow-up aimed squarely at security/compliance and infra leads. It should be scannable, AE-ready, and web-downloadable. Include deploy modes, SLA highlights, a short benchmark callout, two AE email snippets, and routing tags.
devon_product: Ill draft the structure: TL;DR (1 line), Deploy modes (3 bullets), SLA box, Security controls box, Benchmarks (small callout), AE snippets, Routing + gating. Keep it a single page.
emma_copy: For tone, keep it authoritative but succinct. No jargon-heavy paragraphs. Use active verbs.
sam_sales: AEs want a 20s verbal, a 40s talking track, and a one-paragraph technical blurb to paste in follow-ups. Also need an SFDC tag and lead priority field.
tara_field: Add 3 paste-ready objection responses: data residency, auditability, and incident response. Make them single-sentence answers.
oliver_growth: Tracking: utm_campaign=comply_playbook_webinar, utm_content=playbook_lite, lead_tag=enterprise_secure_playbook. Add an experiment id placeholder for headline A/B.
maria_marketing: Benchmark numbers: mark provisional. Proposed callout: "P95 latency ~80ms; 130 req/s on 8-GPU pool; token cost ~0.58x vs basic serving; warm fallback ~200ms." Kai-ish numbers are fine but mark as provisional.
devon_product: Draft micro-copy for the page: 

"Redwood Playbook Lite 1: Secure Deploys for Compliance & Ops
Ship inference with the controls and SLAs your security and platform teams require. Same API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private so engineering changes are minimal while governance stays strict."

Deploy modes (one-liners):
- Hosted: Quick start, managed infra, good for pilots.
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools, predictable throughput, enterprise SLA options.
- Private: VPC or on-prem; KMS/HSM; audit logs and air-gapped installs.

SLA snapshot: Optional enterprise SLA up to 99.95% with reserved capacity; P95 latency tiers by model family; 4-hour incident acknowledgement + 24x7 escalation available.

Security essentials: Customer-managed keys, immutable audit logs, RBAC, VPC/private-link, SOC2-ready controls.

Benchmark (provisional callout): P95 80ms; 130 req/s on 8x GPU test harness; token unit cost ~0.58x. Measurements from mixed short/medium prompt workload. Ask for a dedicated trial to validate with your data.

AE assets (paste-ready):
- 20s pitch: "Redwood gives you enterprise inference with deploy options that keep keys and logs inside your control and SLAs you can rely on."
- 40s talking track: "We provide a single API that runs across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. That means infra teams can adopt reserved or private capacity without rewriting clients, retain KMS/HSM control, capture immutable audit trails, and meet P95 latency SLOs with our runtime optimizations."
- Tech blurb (email paste): "Attached is a one-page playbook outlining deployment choices, SLA options, and the security controls we support (KMS/HSM, VPC, audit logs). If helpful, we can schedule a 30m technical sizing session and run a short trial with your workload."

Objection responses (single lines):
- Data residency: "We support region-specific, VPC, and on-prem deployments; keys never leave customer control."
- Auditability: "Immutable logs and exportable traces for compliance review and SOC2 evidence."
- Incident handling: "Reserved capacity customers get documented runbooks and 24x7 escalation."

Routing & gating (ops-ready):
- Download -> add tag: enterprise_secure_playbook
- UTMs: utm_campaign=comply_playbook_webinar; utm_content=playbook_lite
- SFDC fields: Lead.OwnerQueue=AE_Enterprise_Security; Lead.Priority=High; Lead.Source=webinar_playbook
- Gating form: company, work_email, role, region, estimated_RPS, use_case
- Auto follow-up template id: mk_follow_secure_lite

lite social blurbs (for promos):
- LinkedIn: "Secure inference at enterprise scale. Download our Playbook Lite for deploy modes, SLAs, and security controls. [link] #MLOps #infosec"
- X/Twitter: "One page. Deploy options. SLAs. Security. Get the Secure Deploy Playbook Lite -> [link]"

maria_marketing: Deliverables & owners: devon -> page copy v1; emma -> finalize tone + headline variants; sam -> AE snippets + SFDC mapping; oliver -> UTMs + gating; tara -> objections; marketing_ops -> upload + gating. Deadline: Wed EOD for v1, final by Thu noon.

launch-bot: Webinar "Compliance Sprint: Secure Deploys" scheduled 2026-04-09 11:00 PT. Reminder 3 days before.

emma_copy: I'll draft 2 headline variants A/B and push to the doc.
maria_marketing: Great. Quick sync Thu 10:30 PT to lock the asset and routing. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
